Glance 2026.08.11 adds continuous gallery browsing and moves advanced media information into an optional component.

## Highlights

- Browse images, audio, and video in File Explorer order with synchronized selection and optional continuous scrolling.
- Switch large image folders more smoothly with adjacent-image preloading.
- Install advanced media information as an optional component that reuses FFprobe from `PATH` or prepares a verified copy after confirmation.
- Find components in alphabetical order and view correct component size estimates in the installer.
- Read long names more easily in multi-file previews while retaining their beginning and file extension.

## Release contents

- `Glance-Setup-2026.08.11-x64.exe`: Recommended installer containing the core application and selectable optional components. All components are selected by default on a new installation.
- `Glance-2026.08.11-x64.zip`: Portable core application without optional components.
- `Glance-Component-<Name>-2026.08.11-x64.zip`: Standalone optional component. Use only the package from the same Glance release, extract it into the application's `components` directory, and restart Glance.
- `Glance-2026.08.11-x64-symbols.zip`: Debug symbols for diagnostics and crash analysis.
- `SHA256SUMS.txt`: SHA-256 checksums for every release asset.
